surface_follow.label: Follow surfaces
surface_follow.description: Dragging moves the view center along terrain and object surfaces. Turn it off to keep the current height and pass through obstacles.

ray_steps.label: Ray steps
ray_steps.description: Colors each point on screen by how much work it took to draw: blue for little, red for a lot. Points that borrowed a nearby result and skipped the work are grey.

root.label: From the root
root.description: Walks every point again from the top of the world, started just short of what it shows, and times that walk on its own.

cut_1.label: From the proxy box, 1 coarser
cut_1.description: Walks every point again from the box a proxy would draw over it, 1 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and times that walk on its own.

cut_2.label: From the proxy box, 2 coarser
cut_2.description: Walks every point again from the box a proxy would draw over it, 2 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and times that walk on its own.

cut_3.label: From the proxy box, 3 coarser
cut_3.description: Walks every point again from the box a proxy would draw over it, 3 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and times that walk on its own.

cut_4.label: From the proxy box, 4 coarser
cut_4.description: Walks every point again from the box a proxy would draw over it, 4 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and times that walk on its own.

cut_6.label: From the proxy box, 6 coarser
cut_6.description: Walks every point again from the box a proxy would draw over it, 6 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and times that walk on its own.

cut_8.label: From the proxy box, 8 coarser
cut_8.description: Walks every point again from the box a proxy would draw over it, 8 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and times that walk on its own.

locate_1.label: Find the proxy box only, 1 coarser
locate_1.description: Finds the box a proxy would draw over every point, 1 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, without walking from it, and times that on its own.

locate_2.label: Find the proxy box only, 2 coarser
locate_2.description: Finds the box a proxy would draw over every point, 2 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, without walking from it, and times that on its own.

loose_1.label: From the proxy box as first built, 1 coarser
loose_1.description: Starts at the box front in the box itself, as first built, to compare against the fixed start.

eye_1.label: From the proxy box over the true hit, 1 coarser
eye_1.description: Takes the box over what each point's own ray truly meets, not what the cast drew.

loose_2.label: From the proxy box as first built, 2 coarser
loose_2.description: Starts at the box front in the box itself, as first built, to compare against the fixed start.

eye_2.label: From the proxy box over the true hit, 2 coarser
eye_2.description: Takes the box over what each point's own ray truly meets, not what the cast drew.

cut_1.label: Build the cut, 1 coarser
cut_1.description: Builds the boxes a proxy would draw every frame, 1 size coarser than the camera grid asks, and counts and times them on their own; nothing draws them.

cut_2.label: Build the cut, 2 coarser
cut_2.description: Builds the boxes a proxy would draw every frame, 2 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and counts and times them on their own; nothing draws them.

cut_3.label: Build the cut, 3 coarser
cut_3.description: Builds the boxes a proxy would draw every frame, 3 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, and counts and times them on their own; nothing draws them.

raster_1.label: Build and draw the cut, 1 coarser
raster_1.description: Builds the boxes a proxy would draw every frame, 1 size coarser than the camera grid asks, draws them at every pixel, and times the drawing on its own; nothing reads them yet.

raster_2.label: Build and draw the cut, 2 coarser
raster_2.description: Builds the boxes a proxy would draw every frame, 2 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, draws them at every pixel, and times the drawing on its own; nothing reads them yet.

raster_3.label: Build and draw the cut, 3 coarser
raster_3.description: Builds the boxes a proxy would draw every frame, 3 sizes coarser than the camera grid asks, draws them at every pixel, and times the drawing on its own; nothing reads them yet.
